description:
It started as a cafe to show that the visually impaired and blind could work as chefs. But now social entrepreneur Aaron Yeoh is 'auditioning' a new candidate with cerebral palsy, Oh Siew May, to replace Erna who quit 3 weeks before Kunyah Cafe's opening day.

Despite her difficulties with verbal communication and physical movement, Siew May wants to prove people with disabilities can contribute alongside abled-bodied folks.

About the series:
"Our Blind Kitchen" follows the story of visually impaired chef Alex, cafe founder Aaron and their team as they navigate the challenges and opportunities of opening a cafe run by people with disabilities - Kunyah Cafe, at the Singapore Management University in downtown.
